$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/sales-intake.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). W2b-5, schema wave 37/44 (B-W2b-279): sales intake and customers. The office (factory_runtime) reads and writes through apps/factory-api's modules/parties (B-W2b-290: requirements, holds, terms per company) and modules/sales (B-W2b-295 inquiries, B-W2b-303 seasons), always with command(); the API keeps staff to the companies their grants reach (a company is a column, not a policy key). The floor and link sessions read nothing here: no floor screen shows them. TH-1b (threads plan, schema wave 1/9, B-TH-009): a customer's portal people (factory_partner_runtime, by party) READ their own inquiries and their lines, never the office's columns (hiddenColumns: the assignee and since when, the office note, the decline reason and the words an inquiry was closed with, who closed it, the prospect and its erasure, the mail it came from, the tech pack, the target price, who typed it); the portal's request is made in the tenant's office scope (B-TH-010), so the partner role writes nothing here. TH-2 (threads plan, schema wave 3/9, B-TH-022): an inquiry made into an order names it (salesOrderId, readable by its customer: the order is the customer's own), and the style drafts made from it (styleIds) stay the office's (hidden). InquiryLine carries its inquiry's party (copied by the …_sales_intake_portal_th_guards triggers) for that policy. The other models stay office only (a partyId there is the party key with no partner grant). Money columns: Inquiry.targetUnitPrice, InquiryLine.unitPriceShown (B-TH-009: the price the customer was shown) and PartyCompanyTerms.creditLimitAmount, all @grain price. Personal data: an inquiry's prospect (name, company, e-mail, phone), office only and blanked by erasure (no `personal` entry: the purposes of src/ownership.ts are the people's; the prospect is named by no id); who placed, released, ended or set a row is a person inside the one record. Nothing is deleted but an open inquiry's lines (the …_sales_intake_w2b_guards triggers): inquiries are closed, requirements ended and superseded, holds released, terms ended, seasons closed. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

Inquiry.about: The office logs an inquiry or RFQ (typed, or made from a mail), matches it to a party, assigns it, asks for more, makes the quote it becomes, declines it with a reason or marks it lost, and erases its prospect's personal data on request; never deleted. TH-1b (B-TH-009): its customer's portal people read it (its number, state, what was asked, their PO and delivery address, the quote it became), never the office's columns. TH-1b (B-TH-104): its customerSeq (the customer's own running number, given by the database) is readable by its customer's portal people. TH-2 (B-TH-022): the order it became (salesOrderId) is readable by them too; the style drafts made from it (styleIds) are not. TH-9 (B-TH-090, PR-03): production's answer (productionAnswer, productionNotBefore, when and by whom) is the office's, hidden from them; a request they withdrew reads WITHDRAWN, never which portal person closed it (closedById stays hidden).

InquiryLine.about: The office writes what an inquiry asks for (a style or a description, a colourway, the pieces by size) while the inquiry is open, and removes a line then. TH-1b (B-TH-009): the line carries its inquiry's party (the database copies it), and the inquiry's customer reads the lines of its own requests (never who typed them).

CustomerRequirement.about: The office writes a customer's packing, labelling, document, quality, shipping and invoicing rules, ends one, and replaces one by a new row that supersedes it; never deleted.

PartyHold.about: The office (or the system: a credit check, in the tenant's office scope) puts a customer's account on hold with a reason, and the office releases it with words; never edited or deleted.

PartyCompanyTerms.about: The office sets a tenant-wide customer's terms with one of our companies (payment terms, price list, deposit, PO number required, credit limit), changes them, and ends them; never deleted.

Season.about: The office sets up a company's seasons (code, name, dates, order-book close), and closes or reopens one; never deleted.
